description: Students survey the solo art song repertoire of Germany, Italy, the Iberian peninsula, and Latin
highlights the significant features and development of the art song; provides
context, approaches, and resources for studying this literature; and explores the differences and
similarities between art song and other solo vocal literature.  Offered fall semester in alternate
MUSIC 141 and MUSIC 214 or permission of instructor; MUSIC 263 and MUSIC 264 preferred.
